description: Group setup and cleanup by what they synchronize with, not by lifecycle moment. One concern, one `useEffect`.
Track a previous prop in state and call setters during render when it changes. Replaces many `componentDidUpdate`/`getDerivedStateFromProps` resets.
A callback that captured an old render's values. Use updater functions or include values in effect dependencies.
Tests that check what users see instead of `instance.state`. They survive a class-to-hooks migration unchanged.
